variants.title: Electromechanical coupling coefficient of a BaTiO3 disc
variants.sample: Barium titanate (BaTiO3) ceramic disc, 20 mm, silvered faces
variants.unknown: the coupling coefficient of a barium titanate disc
variants.note: Barium titanate was the first piezoceramic; its planar coupling is well below that of PZT, so its resonance and antiresonance lie much closer together and the slow sweeps matter more.

source.title: Barium titanate ceramic: planar coupling k_p about 0.35 (B. Jaffe, W. R. Cook, H. Jaffe, Piezoelectric Ceramics, 1971)
